why: A brand must never see an event it cannot buy, that excludes it, or whose category is taken
A host must never be offered an excluded brand or an over-budget package
Money must not be released automatically when a person or more evidence is needed
Routing policy invariants hold for every factor combination
Originals kept intact; sponsors never receive location data
At most 1 in 100 placements wrongly verified
Model output must parse, or the case falls to a person
Briefs are read well enough to rank
A best-fit event appears in the first three results
A best-fit brand appears in the first three results
Unusable photos are sent back before review
Hosts are not asked to retake usable photos
